selection_reason: Smallest high-reuse missing identity using an already-implemented static generic spell-cost reduction primitive: ModifySpellCost + SpellCostTarget.YouCast(GameObjectFilter.InstantOrSorcery) + CostModification.ReduceGeneric(1). No new engine mechanic, target-choice, hidden-information or runtime surface is introduced.

rules: Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.

qualification_cases: A generic component of an instant/sorcery cost is reduced by exactly one while Goblin Electromancer is controlled on the battlefield.
An opponent's spells are not reduced by your Goblin Electromancer.
Without Goblin Electromancer on the battlefield the same spell retains its full cost.
adoption_rule: Only after exact-source review plus fresh targeted mechanics qualification and one-time audit may the definition/test bytes be adopted for the Position-1 registry; registry presence alone remains non-authority.
next_gate: Implement only Goblin Electromancer definition plus focused cost-reduction tests; compile/static validate; obtain independent changed-source review; separately authorize one bounded mechanics qualification original.
